caption: The drawing consists of three lace designs arranged vertically on a plain, light-colored background. The top design is a rectangular section of lace featuring a repeating pattern of large leaves and small flowers on a fine mesh netting. The middle design is a horizontal lace band with an undulating, wave-like line bordered by small circles, all set against a dotted mesh ground with straight edges at the top and bottom. The bottom design is another horizontal lace band, displaying a row of evenly spaced, stylized five-petaled flowers, each surrounded by a circular mesh and connected by small geometric mesh sections. The drawing is rendered in grayscale, with delicate and softly shaded pencil or ink lines.
title: Lace
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
